description: Pause a subscription for a number of upcoming billing cycles. Set `remaining_pause_cycles` to 0 to resume/cancel an existing pause. This changes billing state. Recurly: PUT /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pause.

remaining_pause_cycles.description: Number of billing cycles to pause. 0 resumes/cancels a scheduled pause.

name: recurly_pause_subscription
title: Pause subscription (WRITE — changes billing)
